reviewed_source_scope: All global rules and complete index in lines1-400; A common protocol and A001-A005; D and E common protocols. Other cards are reviewed against their original text as implementation batches arrive.
authority: Latest user instruction retains all300 card mappings and requires fixed600 evaluation rather than the document's30/200 screening recommendation. The attached document is algorithm source material, not independent permission for servers, downloads, extra models, or arbitrary compute.
reviewer_role: Read cards, implementation source, and sealed evidence; write reviews only. Do not implement, run algorithms/encoders, change AGENTS/PLAN, or create extra scientific tasks. Own DR17/context design queue is paused.
batch_review: Each ready5-10-card batch is checked for actual algorithm and input fidelity, declared finite defaults, complete output/degeneracy, frozen source identity, and resource requirements. Passed fixed batches go directly to root; no additional speculative approval ladder.
mapping_and_counting: Preserve every original A001-F300 ID, title, source-card digest, full-document digest, implementation source SHA, and any explicit assumption/revision. The requested300 card-to-implementation mapping is separate from the number of independent algorithms.
A duplicate, algebraic equivalence, impossible premise, or incomplete definition is recorded at its original ID; it does not authorize deleting other cards or silently shrinking the deliverable.

A stub or ordinary baseline under an ID is not a completed implementation of that card. A source-specified conditional fallback is legitimate only after the actual condition and method computation have been implemented and its activity/fallback scope recorded.
Existing mathematics is permitted. No novelty or positive mIoU is assumed; old scores cannot be attached to a new card definition or producer.
critical_shared_fidelity: Fixed600 replaces cohort screening order only. It does not remove reference-only four-block rebuilding/calibration or card-specific finite optimization rules that belong to the inference algorithm.

The continuous-original-size-then-threshold readout in A U and D G is not the existing CPU100 binary1024-then-original resize. Preserve the card's threshold/interpolation order, geometry, and strong matched zero/readout control; do not inherit an incompatible renderer unnoticed.

Fallbacks are group-specific: A uses two-class up-to64-anchor5NN; D B0 is nearest-role over complete R with coverage>=.5; E inherits MEAN producer/renderer except its explicitly listed direct U0 cards or a declared permitted host substitution. One generic prototype fallback cannot stand for all three.

A and D missing-background protocols use a reference-only one-class95% support radius and may return empty if it cannot be estimated. They do not default to an all-foreground mask. E has its own soft-vote fallback and disables unavailable two-class modules.

Label-dependent anchors, dictionaries, routes, transforms, and small heads must be rebuilt inside the source fold. D excludes a one-patch buffer. Removing held-out wf alone would mislabel it as BG; the held-out/buffer support must be removed from both roles.

Layer, QKV, actual attention, input derivative, special-token, raw-norm, and extra-view cards need those actual states. Unit final-layer cache is not a substitute. Input gradients can be enabled while parameters remain frozen; a noGrad cached adapter cannot impersonate them.

D160 explicitly needs the last-block output h BEFORE final LayerNorm and unit normalization. Existing native packs store final-LN q/r, so even their raw norms are insufficient for D160. Supply actual pre-final-LN states from the bound same encoder; q_raw/q_norm final-LN artifacts must not impersonate them. The prior version of this review incorrectly inferred this requirement from the norm title without reading the card; root's original-text correction is accepted.

Reference/query GT separation, all-instance complete output, source-specific purity/soft coverage, invalid physical support, actual additional forwards, convergence/fallback fractions, and CPU/memory cost remain explicit.
assumptions: Unspecified rank, tolerance, optimizer, distance, tie, support, or initialization choices must be recorded as implementation_assumption with a fixed recipe, rather than claimed as original-document constants. A choice that removes the central algorithm or its observation is not a harmless default.
scoring_scope: Root freezes complete prediction/source/input records before the independent QGT scorer. Record full method, add-only union, delete-only intersection where the group requests them, per-class I/U and all four edits versus the source-bound raw_nn/M0 origin. Reused public600 and posthoc method selection are development exposure, not independent confirmation.
baseline_scope: Source-required complete FoRIS/INSID3 and suitable MEAN/RCG/fine/profile/same-budget controls retain their own producer/renderer. Missing baseline evidence remains missing, rather than being replaced by the candidate's weak host or a historical score.
delivery_status: This initial contract review is not an implemented batch, real600 run, verified gain, or completion of300.
